raw.details:
Overview

KITE Winter Innovation Expedition 2026 is a two-day innovation-driven challenge organized by KITE Hub, K.S. Rangasamy College of Technology (KSRCT), Tiruchengode, Tamil Nadu.

The initiative is funded by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, through the National Council for Science & Technology Communication (NCSTC).

The National Innovation Challenge invites student innovators and aspiring problem-solvers to identify real-world challenges, develop innovative concepts and work towards practical, technology-enabled solutions.

Participants will explore three critical thematic domains and engage in problem identification, ideation, technical experimentation, prototype development and project presentation.

Challenge Themes

01. Climate Change

Develop innovative solutions addressing environmental challenges, climate resilience, sustainability and environmental monitoring.

02. Waste Processing

Explore solutions for smart waste management, waste segregation, recycling, resource recovery and sustainable waste processing.

03. Food Security

Develop solutions addressing agricultural innovation, food preservation, storage, cold-chain management and food security.

Challenge Structure

Phase 1 – Problem Exploration

Understand the selected thematic challenge and identify the core problem.

Phase 2 – Ideation & Concept Development

Develop innovative solution concepts and define the proposed approach.

Phase 3 – Technical Development

Explore relevant technologies, develop prototypes or proof-of-concepts and refine the proposed solutions.

Phase 4 – Mentoring & Refinement

Receive guidance and improve the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed solutions.

Phase 5 – Project Presentation

Present the developed solution, demonstrate the prototype or proof-of-concept and explain its potential impact.

Phase 6 – Jury Evaluation

Projects will be evaluated by a jury based on predefined assessment criteria.

Evaluation Criteria

The proposed evaluation framework includes:

  • Innovation and originality
  • Relevance to the selected problem
  • Technical feasibility
  • Practical applicability
  • Potential societal and environmental impact
  • Presentation and demonstration

Programme Experiences

In addition to the innovation challenge, participants will experience:

  • Inspiring expert sessions
  • Hands-on IoT and technology laboratories
  • Real-world problem immersion
  • Collaborative ideation
  • Technical mentoring
  • Project demonstrations and showcase

Eligibility

  • Undergraduate and postgraduate students.
  • Students from recognized colleges and institutions.
  • Students interested in innovation, science, technology and entrepreneurship.
  • Participants from interdisciplinary academic backgrounds are encouraged.

Event Details

  • Event: KITE Winter Innovation Expedition 2026
  • Challenge: National Innovation Challenge
  • Dates: 11–12 December 2026
  • Mode: Offline
  • Venue: K.S. Rangasamy College of Technology, Tiruchengode, Tamil Nadu.
  • Organized by: KITE Hub, K.S. Rangasamy College of Technology.
  • Funding Support: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, through NCSTC.

Register and Innovate!

Identify challenges. Develop solutions. Demonstrate innovation.

Be part of the KITE Winter Innovation Expedition 2026 and contribute towards building technology-driven solutions for a sustainable future.
